description: This file defines a feature gate system for managing feature flags within the etcd project, including interfaces, implementations, and functions for handling feature states, defaults, and flags.

classes.name: featureGate
classes.description: Implementation of the MutableFeatureGate interface, managing feature states and flags.

methods.name: setUnsetAlphaGates
methods.description: Sets or unsets all alpha pre-release feature gates based on the provided boolean value.

methods.name: setUnsetBetaGates
methods.description: Sets or unsets all beta pre-release feature gates based on the provided boolean value.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new MutableFeatureGate instance with default features.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses a string of key=value pairs to set feature gates.

methods.name: SetFromMap
methods.description: Sets feature gates from a map of feature names to boolean values.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds new features to the feature gate.

methods.name: OverrideDefault
methods.description: Overrides the default value for a specific feature.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns a copy of all known feature specifications.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is enabled.

methods.name: AddFlag
methods.description: Adds a command-line flag for setting feature gates.

methods.name: KnownFeatures
methods.description: Returns a list of known features excluding deprecated and GA.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the feature gate object.
